public_redaction: Raw photos, full desktop/AX, individual historical file inventory, absolute local personal paths and raw authority data omitted. Numerical summaries derive from unmodified local JSON; raw refs and hashes retained. Public driver is byte-identical to frozen local source.
implementer_report_clarifications: Full-ROI uniqueness was evaluated only on selected up-to-16 patches; not every accepted local match has full-ROI uniqueness proof. Global ambiguity does not filter the local accepted set/hull.
The proposed historical Save All point was computed and never dispatched.
Implementer repeat runs are same-author determinism checks, not independent E2E.
This method failing P1 does not prove the LINE surface intrinsically impossible to register.
